motion_limit: The extended recording is largely stationary. Across a sample of spread-out segments the travel in five seconds was 9.45, 1.46, 0.13, 0.64, 10.13, 3.60 and 3.19 m, median pair displacement 0.46 m. A pair test that validates a prediction when the train arrives needs travel, so a spread sample cannot support one; a contiguous block can. This is the same wall behind the note in CURVED_CORRIDOR_AND_RANGE.md that a subset carries at most about 33 m of travel.

continuation_pair_test.method: a predicted centre at range r in frame N is carried through both poses into a later frame and compared against the rails that frame measures at close range; only look-aheads past the last anchor are scored
readings: curvature beats the tangent at every look-ahead, independently confirming the cross-branch result
the bore error does not grow with range while extrapolation degrades quadratically, so the bore wins past 60 m; at 2.43 m it still exceeds the 1.535 m corridor half-width

bore_availability.note: the symmetry search must span at least +-7.5 m; a narrower window clips curved track and pins the fit

place_recognition.question: how to tell two passes are the same place without GPS
place_recognition.ground_truth: poses say which (frame, range) observations look at the same ground

negative_section_shape.descriptor_1: normalised lateral profile about the section's own axis plus the height distribution
negative_section_shape.result: recognition equals the false-match rate at every threshold: 15 vs 13.9, 25 vs 26.9, 39 vs 49.3 per cent
negative_section_shape.descriptor_2: measured excavation width and height, which are range-invariant by construction
negative_section_shape.result_2: same overlap: 1/1, 2/2, 4/4, 7/7 per cent, and the measured width itself ranges 1.90-9.30 m about a 6.80 m median
negative_section_shape.diagnosis: what a distant lidar sees of a cross-section is decided by range and occlusion, not by the place, so neither the point distribution nor dimensions derived from it identify one

positive_intensity.concentration: median range of the brightest 0.1 per cent is 15 m, p90 65 m
positive_intensity.reading: a station that lights up seen from 10 m also lights up seen from 40 m, which is the viewpoint robustness the section shape lacked. The gap between the Pearson and Spearman figures says a few strong stations carry it, which is what sparse fixed markers would do rather than a smooth field. It also suggests the architecture: recognise the place near, where intensity survives, and let memory supply the far field

open: cross-pass matching is untested and untestable on one pass
distinguishing 'the tunnel is always like this' from 'something is standing here' on a first pass
what to report on a first pass with no memory
ring, in-frame time and return multiplicity are still unexamined
limits: One contiguous block of 174 m of route carries the place work; 12314 pairs carry the continuation test. Along-track position comes from the detector pose, whose longitudinal axis is the degenerate one, so issue #4 bounds what any of this can claim. No labels are involved anywhere.
